endpoint: micronucleated binucleate cell frequency per 1000 BN cells
clinical_status: prospectively validated as a cancer-risk biomarker in a 6718-subject; 10-country cohort
notes: The only endpoint in the panel with prospective cancer-incidence validation. Elevated frequency associated with increased all-cancer incidence and reduced cancer-free survival. Laboratory-specific percentile banding is required because inter-laboratory variability is large

endpoint: percentage tail DNA (strand breaks + alkali-labile sites)
notes: Baseline frequency distributions and the effect of principal confounders are established from pooled international databases; use them for banding rather than inventing local cut-offs

endpoint: net oxidised purine sites (enzyme-treated minus buffer-treated)
pathway_reported: oxidative purine lesion burden in situ
notes: Measures functionally the same lesion class as 8-oxodG but inside intact cells; a divergence between this and the LC-MS/MS 8-oxodG result is the strongest available signal of a DNA-extraction oxidation artefact

endpoint: residual damage at 2h and 24h after a calibrated 2 Gy or H2O2 dose
notes: Turns the panel from a static snapshot into a capacity measurement. Residual damage at 24h is the repair-deficiency read-out; requires a same-day unirradiated control from the same donor

clinical_status: established biodosimetry method; aberration rate prospectively linked to cancer risk
notes: Labour-intensive; reserve for confirming a high micronucleus result rather than running on every subject
